rootCause: M3 mapEmbeddingRecordToProducerRecord substitutes the vector contract ID into the provisional inputHash field; SQLite stores it in vector_contract_id and reprojectLegacyFromSqlite omits embeddingInputHash. M4 then publishes the already-incomplete record.
semanticDefinition: hashContent(buildEmbeddingInput(chunk, prefixMode)); the enriched document input includes basename, path, chunk index, chunk text and document prefix when configured.

searchImpact.binary3E: masks the issue because its reader does not rerun calculateEmbeddingState

recoverability.condition: current chunk and verified preparation identity must be available; missing historical chunks are not recoverable from SQLite, 3E or M4 alone

recommendedFix: SQLite schema v2 adds embedding_input_hash; split ProducerEmbeddingRecord vectorContractId from embeddingInputHash; preserve the real hash through canonical write, reprojection, 3E and M4; perform conservative deterministic backfill only when input can be reconstructed and verified.
historicalFinding: embeddingInputHash existed in Git before M1; no vault backup/checkpoint was available for inspection
